questions.question: Consider the equation [latex]\frac{\mathrm{d} u}{\mathrm{d} t}=3t^{2}+1[/latex] with u=0 at t=0. This is numerically solved by using the forward Euler method with a step size [latex]\Delta t= 2[/latex]. The absolute error in the solution at the end of the first time step is_________
questions.explanation: [latex]  \begin{aligned}   \frac{\mathrm{d} u}{\mathrm{d} t}&=3t^{2}+1 \\ f\left ( u,\: t \right )&=3t^{2}+1 \\ u_{0}&=0 \\ t_{0}&=0 \\ \Delta t&=2\\ &\text{By Euler's method} \\     u_{1}&=u_{0}+hf\left ( u_{0}t_{0} \right )  & t_{1}&=t_{0}+h \\     &=u_{0}+h\left ( 3t^{2}_{0}+1 \right )   &  &=0+2 \\     &=0+2\left ( 3\left ( 0 \right )^{2}+1 \right )   &  &=2 \\     &=2 \end{aligned}[/latex] After first iteration u=0 when t=2, [latex]\begin{aligned}    \frac{\mathrm{d} u}{\mathrm{d} t}&=3t^{2}+1 \\     du&=\left ( 3t^{2}+1 \right )dt \\    \int du&=\int_{0}^{2}\left ( 3t^{2}+1 \right )dt \\     u&=\left.\begin{matrix} \left ( 3\frac{t^{3}}{3}+t \right ) \end{matrix}\right|_{0}^{2} \\     &=8+2=10 \end{aligned}[/latex] Absolute error = Exact value - approx value [latex]=10-2 =8[/latex]
questions.explanation_html:
[latex] \begin{aligned} \frac{\mathrm{d} u}{\mathrm{d} t}&=3t^{2}+1 \\ f\left ( u,\: t \right )&=3t^{2}+1 \\ u_{0}&=0 \\ t_{0}&=0 \\ \Delta t&=2\\ &\text{By Euler's method} \\ u_{1}&=u_{0}+hf\left ( u_{0}t_{0} \right ) & t_{1}&=t_{0}+h \\ &=u_{0}+h\left ( 3t^{2}_{0}+1 \right ) & &=0+2 \\ &=0+2\left ( 3\left ( 0 \right )^{2}+1 \right ) & &=2 \\ &=2 \end{aligned}[/latex]
After first iteration u=0 when t=2,
[latex]\begin{aligned} \frac{\mathrm{d} u}{\mathrm{d} t}&=3t^{2}+1 \\ du&=\left ( 3t^{2}+1 \right )dt \\ \int du&=\int_{0}^{2}\left ( 3t^{2}+1 \right )dt \\ u&=\left.\begin{matrix} \left ( 3\frac{t^{3}}{3}+t \right ) \end{matrix}\right|_{0}^{2} \\ &=8+2=10 \end{aligned}[/latex]
Absolute error = Exact value - approx value
[latex]=10-2 =8[/latex]

questions.question: A 1 m wide rectangular channel carries a discharge of 2 [latex]m^{3}/s[/latex]. The specific energy-depth diagram is prepared for the channel. It is observed in this diagram that corresponding to a particular specific energy; the subcritical depth is twice the supercritical depth. The subcritical depth (in meters, up to two decimal places) is equal to _____
questions.explanation: Let Supercritical depth =Y Subcritical depth =2 Y As the specific energy E remains constant for alternate depths [latex] \begin{aligned} \therefore \quad E_{1}&=E_{2} \\ \Rightarrow Y_{1}+\frac{Q^{2}}{2 g B^{2} Y_{1}^{2}}&=Y_{2}+\frac{Q^{2}}{2 g B^{2} Y_{2}^{2}} \\ \Rightarrow \quad Y+\frac{2^{2}}{2 \times 9.81 \times 1^{2} \times( Y)^{2}}&=2 Y+\frac{2^{2}}{2 \times 9.81 \times 1 \times(2 Y)^{2}} \\ Y+\frac{0.204}{Y^{2}}&=2Y+\frac{0.051}{Y^{2}}\\ \Rightarrow \quad Y=\frac{0.204-0.051}{Y^{2}}&=Y \\ \Rightarrow \quad Y^{3}&=0.1530 \\ \Rightarrow \quad Y&=0.534 \\ \therefore \quad \text{Subcritical depth} \\ &=0.534 \times 2 \\ &=1.0697 \\ &\simeq 1.07 \mathrm{m} \\ \end{aligned}[/latex]

The design discharge of the canal is based on the rice requirements, which has an irrigated area of 2500 ha, base period of 150 days and delta of 130 cm.
